shared: Corvid crime families borrow now, carry Debt with interest, and turn paying it off into permanent buffs.
differ: What Debt is to you: fuel for fights, a tab others pay, or a lock on Tier up.

takes.label: Kills pay the bill
takes.line: Debt repays itself each turn and Skimmers repay it by killing; every repayment fires Repaid: buffs, so fights fund the growth.
takes.look_if: fights where kills pay your bills and buff the flock.

takes.label: Interest feeds the ravens
takes.line: Interest grows ravens +1/+1 per gold paid, other people pay your debts, and Uncle Jack pawns units so you replay them.
takes.look_if: a running tab, pawn-and-replay tricks, and losers paying your debts.

takes.label: Debt locks Tier up
takes.line: While you owe you can't Tier up, losses cost extra hero damage, and Seven pays off only at exactly 7 Debt.
takes.look_if: tempo gambles against a tier lock, and exact-number puzzles.
